summary: First full test of LaunchLoop AI. Backend: created pytest suite (/app/backend/tests/backend_test.py, 29 tests) covering health, auth (demo/register/login/me/401s/bcrypt format), audience CRUD + refresh, generate (4 angles, 5 factors, cache), campaign loop (prediction/synthetic outcome/delta/verdict/learning, real-outcome override, resynth, delete, 404s), public report, leaderboard (global 10 seeds + mine, rank ordering), analytics (totals/trends/factor_avg/empty state) and cross-user isolation — 29/29 passing. Frontend: Playwright e2e over landing→demo login→dashboard, all 6 nav tabs, leaderboard scope toggle (13 global vs 3 mine), analytics (6 recharts charts + best angle/platform cards), full 5-step Create Launch wizard with Gemini generation (4 angle cards with compact bars), angle select → Run Launch → experiment detail (4-stage loop, explainable ViralityScore with per-factor reasons, verdict badge, real-metrics form saved & verdict flipped UNDERPERFORMED→OVERPERFORMED, resynth changed outcome, learning note), share report (public without token, copy-link/download buttons present), signup of a brand-new account with correct empty states, Audience DNA create/AI-suggest/edit/delete, experiment delete, logout. No blocking frontend or backend defects found.

minor.issue: Accepts a raw `dict` body instead of a Pydantic model — no input validation (any JSON shape accepted).
Raw `dict` body, no Pydantic validation; missing headline/body silently scored as empty strings.
Full-replace semantics via AudienceProfileCreate — omitted fields are reset to defaults (works for the UI which always sends full form, but a PATCH-style partial update would be safer).

ui_bugs.issue: Invalid HTML: delete <button data-testid="delete-exp-*"> is nested inside the card <button data-testid="experiment-*">, producing a React 'cannot be a descendant of <button>' hydration console error on every Experiments page load. Functionality still works (stopPropagation), but should be refactored to a div/role=button card.

issues: Sonner toasts render top-right and overlap the top-right primary CTA ('Create Launch' / 'New Audience' header button) — button text is clipped while a toast is visible. Offset the toaster or move it to bottom-right.
'New experiment' button sends logged-out viewers to /login with no context; consider labeling it 'Try LaunchLoop' for public visitors.

action_items: Refactor Experiments.jsx card so the delete button is not nested inside another <button> (removes hydration console error).
Offset the sonner Toaster so it does not overlap top-right header CTAs.
Optional: add Pydantic request models for /api/audiences/refresh and /api/score.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py mixes routing + all business logic (330 lines, acceptable now) but /audiences/refresh and /score take untyped dicts — add Pydantic models for consistency with the rest of the API.
auth.py _extract_token also accepts a cookie named access_token although the app only issues Bearer tokens; harmless but dead path.
All Mongo reads correctly project out _id and password_hash; verified no _id leaks in any response (auth/me, campaigns, audiences, report, leaderboard, outcome/resynth).
Cross-user data isolation verified: another user gets 404 on demo campaigns and an empty audience list.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (1 cosmetic HTML nesting warning, 1 toast overlap)

seed_data_creation: Test-only data: transient registered users (qa_*/test_*@example.com), one 'QA TestBot' campaign (deleted), one 'QA Audience' profile (deleted). Backend pytest fixtures clean up their own TEST_ campaigns/audiences. Registered throwaway users remain in the users collection.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite is at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -v). Note /api/generate returns source='ai' (not 'llm'). Gemini is live and returns 4 angles in ~5-10s; second identical payload returns cached=true. Frontend testids to reuse: hero-demo, demo-login-btn, nav-* , input-product-name/desc, audience-select-<id>, goal-<id>, platform-<name>, step-next, angle-<id>, run-launch-btn, enter-real-btn, real-<metric>, save-real-btn, resynth-btn, pvr-verdict, pvr-<metric>, learning-note, open-report-btn, copy-link-btn, download-report-btn, scope-global/scope-mine, leaderboard-row-<rank>, experiment-<id>, delete-exp-<id>, edit-audience-<id>, delete-audience-<id>. CountUp animates numbers, so screenshots taken <1.5s after load show partially-counted scores (not a bug).
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defect requiring RCA. The only console error is a React DOM-nesting warning caused by button-in-button markup in Experiments.jsx (line ~56 card button wrapping the line ~75 delete button).
